name: Cosine-Warmup → Stable → Cosine-Decay (WSC)
tagline: Three-phase schedule with cosine warmup (5% min), constant peak for ~67%, and cosine cooldown over the final 28%.
formula: $$\eta(t) = \begin{cases} \eta_{\min} + (\eta_{\max}-\eta_{\min})\cdot \tfrac{1}{2}\big(1-\cos(\pi\,\tfrac{t+1}{W+1})\big) & t < W,\\[2pt] \eta_{\max} & W \le t < 0.72\,T,\\[2pt] \eta_{\min} + (\eta_{\max}-\eta_{\min})\cdot \tfrac{1}{2}\big(1+\cos(\pi\,\tfrac{t-0.72T}{0.28T})\big) & 0.72T \le t \le T,\\[2pt] \eta_{\min} & t > T,\end{cases}\quad W = \max(W_0, 0.05\,T).$$

key_hyperparams.name: stable_end_fraction
key_hyperparams.role: fraction of training before cooldown begins

init_recovers: Standard cosine when stable phase length → 0
diff_from_baseline: Versus cosine baseline, replaces linear warmup with a half-cosine ramp and inserts an explicit constant plateau at peak LR (until 72%); cooldown is also half-cosine instead of full cosine over the entire run.

name: Exponential Warmup + Hold + Cosine
tagline: Saturating exponential warmup, 30% hold at peak, then cosine decay (paired with a longer 8% warmup override).
formula: $$\eta(t) = \begin{cases} \eta_{\max}\,(1 - e^{-5\,t/W}) & t < W,\\[2pt] \eta_{\max} & W \le t < W + 0.3(T-W),\\[2pt] \eta_{\min} + \tfrac{\eta_{\max}-\eta_{\min}}{2}\big(1+\cos(\pi\tfrac{t - h}{T - h})\big) & t \ge h = W + 0.3(T-W),\end{cases}$$

key_hyperparams.name: hold_frac
key_hyperparams.role: fraction of post-warmup steps held at peak

init_recovers: Cosine baseline when hold_frac=0 and warmup uses 1-exp(-5t/W) ≈ linear
diff_from_baseline: Versus cosine, swaps linear warmup for a saturating 1-e^{-5t/W} ramp, inserts a 30% hold at peak, then cosine-decays over the rest, with warmup length doubled to 8%.

name: Two-Stage Cosine Decay (TSCD)
tagline: After linear warmup, slow-cosine-decay to 80% of peak LR, then a fast cosine cooldown over the final 20%.
formula: $$\eta(t) = \begin{cases} \eta_{\max}\,\tfrac{t+1}{W+1} & t < W,\\[3pt] \eta_{\mathrm{mid}} + \tfrac{\eta_{\max} - \eta_{\mathrm{mid}}}{2}\big(1 + \cos(\pi \tfrac{t-W}{0.8T-W})\big) & W \le t < 0.8T,\\[3pt] \eta_{\min} + \tfrac{\eta_{\mathrm{mid}} - \eta_{\min}}{2}\big(1 + \cos(\pi \tfrac{t-0.8T}{0.2T})\big) & 0.8T \le t \le T,\end{cases}\ \eta_{\mathrm{mid}} = 0.8\,\eta_{\max}.$$

key_hyperparams.name: cooldown_start
key_hyperparams.role: split between slow and fast decay

key_hyperparams.name: mid_lr
key_hyperparams.role: intermediate LR floor for first cosine stage

key_hyperparams.name: CONFIG_OVERRIDES
key_hyperparams.role: no override of warmup or min_lr

diff_from_baseline: Versus cosine, splits the decay into two cosines: a gentle decay from peak to 0.8·peak over the first ~76% of post-warmup, then a steeper cosine cooldown to min_lr over the final 20%.

name: Sqrt Warmup + 65% Hold + Long Cosine Tail
tagline: Concave sqrt warmup, hold at peak until 65%, then cosine decay over the final 35% — but to a floor of 10% above min_lr (and overall min_lr is set to lr/25).
formula: $$\eta(t) = \begin{cases} \eta_{\max}\,\sqrt{(t+1)/(W+1)} & t < W,\\[2pt] \eta_{\max} & W \le t < 0.65\,T,\\[2pt] \eta_{f} + \tfrac{\eta_{\max} - \eta_{f}}{2}\big(1 + \cos(\pi \tfrac{t - 0.65T}{0.35T})\big) & 0.65T \le t \le T,\\[2pt] \eta_{\min} & t > T,\end{cases}\quad \eta_f = \eta_{\min} + 0.10(\eta_{\max} - \eta_{\min}).$$

key_hyperparams.name: cosine floor offset
key_hyperparams.role: decay never quite reaches min_lr during cosine

init_recovers: Trapezoidal-style WSD when warmup→linear and cosine→linear
diff_from_baseline: Versus cosine, uses a sqrt warmup that ramps faster, a 65% peak hold (vs no hold), then a half-cosine decay over the final 35% to a floor 10% above min_lr; min_lr is also pushed down to lr/25.

name: Sin² Warmup + 70% Hold + Warped Cosine Decay
tagline: Sin² warmup (zero initial gradient), 70% peak hold, then a power-warped (γ=0.6) cosine decay over the final 30%.
formula: $$\eta(t) = \begin{cases} \eta_{\max}\,\sin^2\!\big(\tfrac{\pi}{2}\cdot\tfrac{t+1}{W+1}\big) & t < W,\\[3pt] \eta_{\max} & W \le t < 0.7\,T,\\[3pt] \eta_{\min} + \tfrac{\eta_{\max}-\eta_{\min}}{2}\big(1 + \cos(\pi\,t'^{\gamma})\big) & 0.7T \le t \le T,\end{cases}\ t' = \tfrac{t - 0.7T}{0.3T},\ \gamma = 0.6.$$

key_hyperparams.name: warmup shape
key_hyperparams.role: smooth warmup that protects Adam moments

key_hyperparams.name: warp γ
key_hyperparams.role: exponent on cosine argument; <1 → faster early decay

init_recovers: Standard half-cosine decay when γ = 1 and stable_fraction = 0
diff_from_baseline: Versus cosine, replaces linear warmup with sin² (0 grad at start), inserts a 70% peak hold, and reshapes the cooldown by exponentiating the cosine argument with γ = 0.6 so initial decay is steeper and the tail is gentler.
